Bullets: Saturn rules your sign, giving you a principled, humane, idea-driven airy nature
Your strengths: principled commitment, a humanitarian instinct, loyalty, and systems thinking

CurrentDasha.Body: Rahu's mahadasha amplifies worldly desires, foreign connections, and unconventional paths.

UpcomingDashas.Body: Jupiter's mahadasha brings wisdom, fortune, children, dharmic activities, and growth.
Saturn's mahadasha emphasizes discipline, slow growth, hard work, and karmic lessons over its 19-year span.

Houses.Body: The ascendant governs the self, body, temperament, and overall vitality, the lens through which the whole chart expresses. Its lord currently occupies house 11, channelling these themes there.
Governs accumulated wealth, family, speech, food, and early upbringing, the resources and values one gathers. Its lord currently occupies house 5, channelling these themes there.

Yogas.Effect: A conjunction of two planets, their significations blend and jointly colour the affairs of the house they occupy.
A conjunction of two planets, their significations blend and jointly colour the affairs of the house they occupy.

Mangal.Body: Mars sits in house 10 from the Lagna in a position that classically triggers Manglik, BUT the dosha is cancelled, own/exalted placement or benefic cancellation removes the affliction.

Predictions.Body: Career suits engineering, defence, surgery, real-estate, or any high-energy execution discipline. Push through opposition rather than going around it.
Partnership benefits from a confident, public-facing spouse. Watch the tendency to dominate decisions; share the spotlight.
